_comment_couplings: Bond-coupling ratios passed to the simulator. The MC sets k1=r1, k2=r2, k3=k3 (always 1.0 in the standard normalisation).
_comment_lattices: List of lattices to simulate. Each entry MUST give an integer L (used only as a label / 1-L axis position) plus the four-tuple geometry [Lx, Ly, Tx, Ty] for both the 'test' and 'ref' families. Use whatever family names you like; both are simulated identically.
_comment_mc: Production MC settings (run at beta = beta_c for each lattice).
_comment_beta_c_finder: Three-pass Gram-Charlier susceptibility-peak scan. beta_lo / beta_hi bracket the search; n_coarse points in pass 0, n_refine{,2,3} in passes 1/2/3. n_traj_coarse is used in pass 0 only, n_traj_fine in passes 1-3. max_shifts is the bracket-translation budget when the GC peak hits an edge.
_comment_plots: Both plots show G_conn(t_k) vs 1/L. 'eighths' draws the full t_k = k/8 (k=1..7) panel grid with linear / quadratic / power-A continuum fits per t_k. 'midpoints' shows only the t = 1/2 sample per cycle, data only.
